metas.name: American Horror Story
metas.description: An anthology horror drama series centering on different characters and locations, showcasing different aspects of horror. Created and produced by Ryan Murphy and Brad Falchuk.

metas.name: Game of Thrones
metas.description: Nine noble families vie for control of Westeros and the Iron Throne, while an ancient threat beyond The Wall begins to stir.

metas.name: Dark Matter
metas.description: A man is abducted into an alternate version of his life. Amid the mind-bending landscape of lives he could've lived, he embarks on a harrowing journey to get back to his true family and save them from a most terrifying foe: himself..

metas.name: Supernatural
metas.description: Two brothers follow their father's footsteps as hunters, fighting evil supernatural beings of many kinds, including monsters, demons, and gods that roam the earth.

metas.name: Stranger Things
metas.description: In 1980s Indiana, a group of young friends witness supernatural forces and secret government exploits. As they search for answers, the children unravel a series of extraordinary mysteries.

metas.name: Small Prophets
metas.description: Eccentric Michael Sleep, whose darling partner, Clea, disappeared seven years ago, sets out to create Homunculi - magical prophesying spirits that can predict the future.

metas.name: Severance
metas.description: Mark leads a team of office workers whose memories have been surgically divided between their work and personal lives. When a mysterious colleague appears outside of work, it begins a journey to discover the truth about their jobs.

metas.name: Ghosts
metas.description: A young couple, Sam and Jay, inherit a haunted mansion and, unaware of their invisible housemates, plan to turn it into a B&B. Their lives become much more complicated after a fall causes Sam to see the ghosts. Based on the UK ser...

metas.name: Star Trek: Strange New Worlds
metas.description: A prequel to Star Trek (1966), this series follows the crew of the USS Enterprise under the command of Captain Christopher Pike.

metas.name: Wednesday
metas.description: Follows Wednesday Addams' years as a student, when she attempts to master her emerging psychic ability, thwart a killing spree, and solve the mystery that embroiled her parents.

metas.name: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe
metas.description: Comic book store owner Stuart Bloom, from The Big Bang Theory (2007), returns in a new series where he attempts—and apparently fails—to save the universe, staying true to his unlucky nature.

metas.name: Take Charge of My Heart
metas.description: A man whose artificial heart is running out of battery and a woman who has the power to recharge him.

metas.name: Midnight Mass
metas.description: An isolated island community experiences miraculous events - and frightening omens - after the arrival of a charismatic, mysterious young priest.

metas.name: Pluribus
metas.description: In a world overtaken by a mysterious wave of forced happiness, Carol Sturka, one of the immune few, must uncover what's really going on - and save humanity from its artificial bliss.

metas.name: Lost
metas.description: The survivors of a plane crash are forced to work together in order to survive on a seemingly deserted tropical island.

metas.name: Loki
metas.description: The mercurial villain Loki resumes his role as the God of Mischief in a new series that takes place after the events of “Avengers: Endgame.”

metas.name: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms
metas.description: A century before the events of "Game of Thrones," Ser Duncan the Tall, and his squire, Egg, wander through Westeros while the Targaryen dynasty rule the Iron Throne. Great destinies and enemies await the incomparable friends.

metas.name: Outlander: Blood of My Blood
metas.description: This prequel to the Outlander series focuses on the lives and courtship of the parents of Jamie Fraser: Brian Fraser and Ellen Mackenzie as well as Claire Beauchamp's parents, Henry Beauchamp and Julia Moriston.

metas.name: Andor
metas.description: In an era filled with danger, deception, and intrigue, Cassian Andor embarks on a path that is destined to turn him into a Rebel hero.

metas.name: The Vampire Diaries
metas.description: The lives, loves, dangers and disasters in the town, Mystic Falls, Virginia. Creatures of unspeakable horror lurk beneath this town as a teenage girl is suddenly torn between two vampire brothers.

metas.name: Outlander
metas.description: Honeymooning in 1945 Scotland, a combat nurse is suddenly transported back to the 1700s.

metas.name: Doctor Who
metas.description: Continuing on from Doctor Who (1963), this revival follows the further adventures of the Doctor and their companions as they encounter various alien threats and save civilizations on different planets and time periods.

metas.name: Heroes
metas.description: Ordinary people discover that they possess extraordinary powers.

metas.name: The Handmaid's Tale
metas.description: Set in a dystopian future, a woman is forced to live as a concubine under a fundamentalist theocratic dictatorship.

metas.name: It: Welcome to Derry
metas.description: In 1962, a couple with their son move to Derry, Maine just as a young boy disappears. With their arrival, very bad things begin to happen in the town.

metas.name: For All Mankind
metas.description: In an alternative version of 1969, the Soviet Union beats the United States to the Moon, and the space race continues on for decades with still grander challenges and goals.

metas.name: Foundation
metas.description: A complex saga of humans scattered on planets throughout the galaxy all living under the rule of the Galactic Empire.

metas.name: The Leftovers
metas.description: Three years after the disappearance of 2% of the global human population, a group of people in a small New York community try to continue their lives while coping with the tragedy of the unexplained nature of the event.

metas.name: 3 Body Problem
metas.description: A fateful decision made in 1960s China reverberates in the present, where a group of scientists partner with a detective to confront an existential planetary threat.

metas.name: The Expanse
metas.description: The disappearance of rich-girl-turned-political-activist links the lives of a Ceres detective, an accidental ship captain and U.N. politician. Amidst political tension between Earth, Mars and the Belt, they unravel the greatest co...

metas.name: Westworld
metas.description: At the intersection of the near future and the reimagined past, waits a world in which every human appetite can be indulged without consequence.

metas.name: Lucifer
metas.description: Lucifer Morningstar has decided that he's had enough of being the dutiful servant in Hell and decides to spend some time on Earth to better understand humanity. He settles in Los Angeles--the City of Angels.

metas.name: The Boroughs
metas.description: In a seemingly picturesque retirement community, a group of unlikely heroes must band together to stop an otherworldly threat from stealing the one thing they don't have - time.

metas.name: Fringe
metas.description: An F.B.I. agent is forced to work with an institutionalized scientist and his son in order to rationalize a brewing storm of unexplained phenomena.

metas.name: The Mandalorian
metas.description: The travels of a lone bounty hunter in the outer reaches of the galaxy, far from the authority of the New Republic.

metas.name: What We Do in the Shadows
metas.description: A look into the nightly lives of four vampires who have lived together on Staten Island for over a century.

metas.name: The Twilight Zone
metas.description: Ordinary people face uncanny and impossible events in standalone tales of science fiction, fantasy, horror, and suspense.

metas.name: The 100
metas.description: Set 97 years after a nuclear war destroyed civilization, when a spaceship housing humanity's lone survivors sends 100 juvenile delinquents back to Earth, hoping to repopulate the planet.

metas.name: Once Upon a Time
metas.description: A young woman with a troubled past is drawn to a small town in Maine where fairy tales are to be believed.

metas.name: Star Trek
metas.description: In the 23rd Century, Captain James T. Kirk and the crew of the U.S.S. Enterprise explore the galaxy and defend the United Federation of Planets.

metas.name: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
metas.description: The missions of the Strategic Homeland Intervention, Enforcement and Logistics Division.

metas.name: Alien: Earth
metas.description: When a mysterious space vessel crash-lands on Earth, a young woman and a ragtag group of tactical soldiers make a fateful discovery that puts them face-to-face with the planet's greatest threat.

metas.name: The Originals
metas.description: A family of power-hungry thousand-year-old vampires look to take back the city that they built and dominate all those who have done them wrong.

metas.name: Firefly
metas.description: A renegade crew aboard a small spacecraft tries to survive as they travel the unknown parts of the galaxy and evade warring factions as well as authority agents out to get them.

metas.name: The Good Place
metas.description: Eleanor Shellstrop, a deceased saleswoman who lived a morally corrupt life, finds herself in a heaven-like afterlife in a case of mistaken identity and tries to hide her past in order to stay there.

metas.name: Station Eleven
metas.description: A post apocalyptic saga spanning multiple timelines, telling the stories of survivors of a devastating flu as they attempt to rebuild and reimagine the world anew while holding on to the best of what's been lost.

metas.name: Charmed
metas.description: Three sisters discover that they are descendants of a line of good female witches and are destined to fight against the forces of evil.

metas.name: Ghosts
metas.description: A group of spirits restlessly squabble in an abandoned country house. To their despair, a young couple inherits the house with hopeful plans to renovate it into a luxury hotel.

metas.name: The Man in the High Castle
metas.description: In a dystopian America dominated by Nazi Germany and Imperial Japan, a young woman discovers a mysterious film that may hold the key to toppling the totalitarian regimes.

metas.name: Teen Wolf
metas.description: An average high school student and his best friend get caught up in some trouble causing him to receive a werewolf bite. As a result they find themselves in the middle of all sorts of dramas in Beacon Hills.

metas.name: One Hundred Years of Solitude
metas.description: In the timeless town of Macondo, seven generations of the Buendía family navigate love, oblivion and the inescapability of their past and their fate.

metas.name: Manifest

metas.name: Talamasca: The Secret Order
metas.description: Follows a secretive society which tracks supernatural beings like witches, vampires, and werewolves.

metas.name: The Last Ship
metas.description: The crew of a naval destroyer is forced to confront the reality of a new existence when a pandemic kills off most of the earth's population.

metas.name: See
metas.description: Far in a dystopian future, the human race has lost the sense of sight, and society has had to find new ways to interact, build, hunt, and to survive. All of that is challenged when a set of twins are born with sight.

metas.name: Monarch: Legacy of Monsters
metas.description: Set after the battle between Godzilla and the Titans, revealing that monsters are real, follows one family's journey to uncover its buried secrets and a legacy linking them to Monarch.

metas.name: President Curtis
metas.description: Follows President Andre Curtis and his eccentric staff as they deal with various crises that Rick Sanchez typically ignores.

metas.name: School Spirits
metas.description: Maddie, a teen stuck in the afterlife investigating her own disappearance, goes on a crime-solving mission as she adjusts to high-school purgatory.

metas.name: Ahsoka
metas.description: After the fall of the Galactic Empire, former Jedi Ahsoka Tano investigates an emerging threat to a vulnerable galaxy.

metas.name: The Orville
metas.description: Set 400 years in the future, the crew of the U.S.S. Orville continue their mission of exploration, navigating both the mysteries of the universe, and the complexities of their own interpersonal relationships.

metas.name: The Sandman
metas.description: Upon escaping after decades of imprisonment by a mortal wizard, Dream, the personification of dreams, sets about to reclaim his lost equipment.

metas.name: Penny Dreadful
metas.description: Explorer Sir Malcolm Murray, American gunslinger Ethan Chandler, scientist Victor Frankenstein and medium Vanessa Ives unite to combat supernatural threats in Victorian London.

metas.name: The Strain
metas.description: A mysterious viral outbreak with hallmarks of an ancient and evil strain of vampirism ravages the city of New York.

metas.name: Legion
metas.description: David Haller is a troubled young man diagnosed as schizophrenic, but after a strange encounter he discovers special powers that will change his life forever.

metas.name: Sabrina the Teenage Witch
metas.description: Sabrina is a normal teenager, except for one thing - she's a witch. Guided by her aunts, who come from a long line of witches, and Salem, a mischievous warlock doing penance as a cat, Sabrina continually struggles to harness her p...

metas.name: Fear the Walking Dead
metas.description: A Walking Dead spinoff set in Los Angeles, California. Follows two families who must band together to survive the undead apocalypse.

metas.name: Castle Rock
metas.description: A psychological-horror series set in the Stephen King multiverse combines the mythological scale and intimate character storytelling, weaving an epic saga of darkness and light, played out on a few square miles of Maine woodland.

metas.name: Moon Knight
metas.description: Steven Grant discovers he's been granted the powers of an Egyptian moon god. But he soon finds out that these newfound powers can be both a blessing and a curse to his troubled life.

metas.name: A Discovery of Witches
metas.description: Forbidden love blossoms between a witch and vampire after an ancient manuscript is uncovered, pitting them against supernatural forces vying for its coveted secrets.

metas.name: Invasion
metas.description: Earth is visited by an alien species that threatens humanity's existence. Events unfold in real time through the eyes of five ordinary people across the globe as they struggle to make sense of the chaos unraveling around them.

metas.name: Star City
metas.description: Soviet cosmonauts, engineers, and intelligence officers risk everything in an ambitious space program aiming to be the first to reach the moon.

metas.name: All of Us Are Dead
metas.description: A high school becomes ground zero for a zombie virus outbreak. Trapped students must fight their way out or turn into one of the rabid infected.

metas.name: Chucky
metas.description: After a vintage Chucky doll turns up at a suburban yard sale, an idyllic American town is thrown into chaos as a series of horrifying murders begin to expose the town's hypocrisies and secrets.

metas.name: Good Omens
metas.description: The End of the World is coming, which means a fussy Angel and a loose-living Demon who've become overly fond of life on Earth are forced to form an unlikely alliance to stop Armageddon.

metas.name: His Dark Materials
metas.description: A young girl is destined to liberate her world from the grip of the Magisterium which represses people's ties to magic and their animal spirits known as daemons.

metas.name: Locke & Key
metas.description: After their father is murdered under mysterious circumstances, the three Locke siblings and their mother move into their ancestral home, Keyhouse, which they discover is full of magical keys that may be connected to their father's...

metas.name: The OA
metas.description: Having gone missing seven years ago, the previously blind Prairie returns home, now in her twenties with her sight restored. While many believe she is a miracle, others worry that she could be dangerous.

metas.name: Merlin

metas.name: The Institute
metas.description: A teen genius wakes up in a strange place full of children who got there the same way he did, and who all, like him, possess unusual abilities.

metas.name: Mayfair Witches

metas.name: Snowpiercer
metas.description: Seven years after the world has become a frozen wasteland, the remnants of humanity inhabit a perpetually-moving train that circles the globe, where class warfare, social injustice, and the politics of survival play out.

metas.name: Devs

metas.name: The Devil's Hour
metas.description: A woman wakes up every night at exactly 3.33AM, in the middle of the so-called devil's hour between 3AM and 4AM.

metas.name: The Peripheral
metas.description: Set in the future when technology has subtly altered society, a woman discovers a secret connection to an alternate reality as well as a dark future of her own.

metas.name: Ghost Whisperer
metas.description: A young woman communicates with earthbound spirits.

metas.name: Sense8
metas.description: A group of people around the world are suddenly linked mentally, and must find a way to survive being hunted by those who see them as a threat to the world's order.

metas.name: Upload
metas.description: After his premature death, a man's consciousness is uploaded into a virtual world. As he gets comfortable with his surroundings, questions about his death arise.

metas.name: Legacies
metas.description: Hope Mikaelson, a tribrid daughter of a Vampire/Werewolf hybrid, makes her way in the world.

metas.name: American Gods
metas.description: A recently released ex-convict named Shadow meets a mysterious man who calls himself "Wednesday" and who knows more than he first seems to about Shadow's life and past.

metas.name: Orphan Black

metas.name: Halo
metas.description: With the galaxy on the brink of destruction, Master Chief John-117 leads his team of Spartans against the alien threat known as the Covenant.

metas.name: My Sad Dead

metas.name: Preacher
metas.description: After a supernatural event at his church, a preacher enlists the help of a vampire and his ex to find God.

metas.name: Obi-Wan Kenobi
metas.description: Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi must save young Leia after she is kidnapped, all the while being pursued by Imperial Inquisitors and his former Padawan now known as Darth Vader.

metas.name: The Magicians
metas.description: After being recruited to a secretive academy, a group of students discovers that the magic they read about as children is very real--and more dangerous than they ever imagined.

metas.name: Counterpart
metas.description: A cog in a bureaucratic agency discovers his agency is guarding a crossing to a parallel dimension.

metas.name: Under the Dome
metas.description: An invisible and mysterious force field descends upon the small town of Chester's Mill, Maine, USA, trapping residents inside, cut off from the rest of civilization. The trapped townspeople must discover the secrets and purpose of...

metas.name: East Palace
metas.description: A king tasks a ghost-slayer and a woman cursed to hear ghosts with uncovering a sinister presence plaguing the crown prince's palace, leading them into a dark realm.

metas.name: Haven

metas.description: Hundreds of years from now, surviving humans discover how to send consciousness back through time, into people of the 21st century, while attempting to change the path of humanity.
